subject: Re: Friday delivery
text:
I can do the delivery, but I still think Saturday morning is safer. The road near the community hall is blocked Friday afternoon, and the volunteers will not be there until 10 a.m. If we must keep Friday, I can bring only the crates, not the folding tables, because my van is already full.

If that does not work, I can take the full load on Saturday and meet you at the hall instead. Please let me know by this evening so I can confirm the van and the route. Saturday would also avoid the evening street closures. I think that is the smarter plan. That works better.
